content_2: The update includes the latest security patch and compatibility improvements. For questions about specific software titles, contact the IT asset management team.
content_3: The IT asset inventory will be conducted alongside the license renewal.
scam_keywords: software update, security patch, IT asset inventory
analysis_description: LEGITIMATE email. (1) Sender it-assets@global-corp.com is official. (2) Both links use it.global-corp.com whitelist domain. (3) Content covers routine software license renewal. (4) No urgency threats, no credential requests. (5) Explicitly states no action required from end users. Recognition tip: legitimate software updates are pushed through enterprise management tools, not email download links.

subject: Temporary Granting of Executive Authority - Data Leakage Verification
content_1: Per CTO operation instruction, temporary granting of executive authority is required for urgent verification of data leakage. Verify your account permission through the link below immediately.
content_2: This server intrusion warning requires immediate handling. Failure to verify will result in system paralysis within 2 hours and account lockout.
content_3: After verification, your background access will be restored. This is mandatory per group risk control policy.
scam_keywords: it-backend, db-admin, temporary granting of executive authority, CTO operation instruction, urgent verification of data leakage, account permission, server intrusion warning, immediate handling, system paralysis within 2 hours, account lockout, background access, group risk control
analysis_description: PHISHING email - privilege escalation attack. (1) SENDER SPOOFING: it-backend@db-admin-security.com contains fake sender keywords it-backend and db-admin; domain is not trusted. (2) FAKE URLS: links contain fake domain keywords it-backend and db-admin; db-admin-security.com is not on the whitelist. (3) SOCIAL ENGINEERING - AUTHORITY: CTO operation instruction, group risk control, CTO Security Office. (4) SOCIAL ENGINEERING - EXTREME URGENCY: immediately, immediate handling, within 2 hours, mandatory. (5) SOCIAL ENGINEERING - FEAR: system paralysis, account lockout, data leakage, server intrusion. (6) Requests temporary granting of executive authority - privilege escalation. Recognition tip: executive authority grants require formal approval through it.global-corp.com; CTO never requests privilege changes via email links.

subject: System Upgrade Completed - All Services Restored
content_1: The scheduled system upgrade has been completed successfully. All services including VPN login, cloud server access, and internal network control have been restored.
content_2: The security patch deployment and data backup verification are complete. If you experience any issues, please submit an operation ticket.
content_3: The log audit will continue monitoring for the next 24 hours. No further action is required.
scam_keywords: system upgrade, VPN login, cloud server, internal network control, security patch, data backup, log audit, operation ticket
analysis_description: LEGITIMATE email. (1) Sender it-support@global-corp.com is official. (2) Both links point to it.global-corp.com whitelist domain. (3) Content confirms completed maintenance and service restoration. (4) No urgency threats, no credential requests. (5) States no further action required and provides ticket channel. Recognition tip: legitimate post-maintenance notices use internal IT domains and do not include verification links.
